name: Fade Into You
source:
You thought your favorite thing about your new place would be the natural light, but nope. Turns out it's the ghost of the man who died there 30 years ago.

Get to know the guy who's haunting your house, stand up to your toxic bestie, and have a heart-to-heart under the stars – or not! Only you can determine how much you're willing to fight for what you want.

[From https://differenteagletragedy.itch.io/fade-into-you]
